Extended verify-report with payload provenance checks, unauthorized-modification detection, multi-pass lineage validation, and canonical pass-evaluation enforcement. Added next-pass-context CLI helper. Added 14-case fixture test suite. Updated templates, workflow, and role docs. All validations pass; backward compatible.
